subject: How to bind_rows with a reactive dataframe

messages.author: a6f35117e675c51c
messages.subject: How to bind_rows with a reactive dataframe
parts:
How to bind_rows with a reactive df() and save the rest back to df without creating cyclical dependency

---
title: "reactive Test"
runtime: shiny
output: html_document
---

```{r echo=FALSE}

df <- reactive(data.frame(x = c(1:5), y = LETTERS[1:5]))
renderTable(df())

#How do I save it back to df
reactive(bind_rows(df(), data.frame(x = c(11:15), y = LETTERS[11:15])))
renderTable(df())
         
```

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How to bind_rows with a reactive dataframe
parts: You don't assign it back to df, you just save it to a new variable name and use that new name for anything that wants the new version.
